title: bitcoindatalabs-mcp: Zero-Clone Model Context Protocol Server for Bitcoin Data Labs Open Datasets
description: Open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing reproducible empirical datasets from Bitcoin Data Labs (501(c)(3)), covering 1,009-repo open-source software security posture, Bitcoin Core engineering governance, BIP status, developer funding, Lightning Network security research (arXiv:2610.20952, arXiv:2610.30350, arXiv:2611.16311), mining pool concentration, and Coldcard RNG forensic aggregates.
